english_json: "May blessed N., virgin and martyr, who was ever pleasing to Thee by her merit of chastity and by her extolling of Thy power, implore Thy forgiveness for us, we beseech Thee, O Lord. Through our Lord."
"Graciously accept, O Lord, the sacrifices dedicated to the merits of blessed N., Thy virgin and martyr, and grant them as a perpetual aid in our behalf. Through our Lord."
